context: M31 o3. The shop on W 37th. A key on a string in Delphine's palm, or an empty hand.

choices.disabledText: Needs a clean count and Nick's word.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Two chairs. A sink. A window. Rule one: I don't hold money I can't count.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Rule sixteen: sometimes you spend it. On something real.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: No shop. Not yet. The club's the shop. Twenty women, one table.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Twelve families and twenty women. One pot. Mrs. Baek counts. I count. Nobody steals.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: The women voted. I didn't decide for them. That's the rule that matters.
